INTRO DATE
NAN 20,2026

ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance is hereby amended by changing all the RS-3 Residential Single-Unit
(Detached House) District symbols and indications as shown on Map No.3-K in

the area bounded by

A line 260.05 feet north of and parallel to West Le Moyne Street;
North Keystone Avenue; a line 222.05 feet north of and parallel
to West Le Moyne Street; and the alley next west of and parallel
to North Keystone Avenue,

to those of a RT4 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage

and due publication.

Common address of property: 1522 North Keystone Avenue
